title: BatteryBecameWaste
description: The content of the operation BatteryBecameWaste: the waste receiver tells the data provider of a passport and the successor that the battery became waste.

passportIdentifier.description: The passport identifier of the passport of the waste battery.

successorBpnl.description: The Business Partner Number of the successor that takes over the responsibility for the passport.

date.description: The date and time at which the battery became waste.
